evidence.title: About Aelthoren
evidence.text_excerpt:
About Aelthoren

Lightweight. Private. Account-free.

Linux development build · Firefox ESR 153.6.0esr

An independent browser project using Mozilla Firefox, Gecko and SpiderMonkey. Not endorsed by Mozilla.

Privacy defaults disable browser accounts, Sync and telemetry uploads, enable tracking protection, and use DuckDuckGo initially. You can change your search engine and privacy settings. Security services can still connect to Mozilla and other providers; this is not an anonymity guarantee.

Uses official precompiled Gecko artifacts. Independent release signing, updates and complete native identity are not yet available.
